jamaica.title: Flag of Jamaica

colors.note: Diagonal saltire; represents the natural wealth and beauty of sunlight on the land.
Top and bottom triangles; represents hope and agricultural richness.
Hoist and fly triangles; represents the strength and creativity of the Jamaican people.

desc:
- A gold saltire on a field divided into four triangles: green at the top and bottom, black at the hoist and fly
- Adopted on 6 August 1962, the day Jamaica became independent from the United Kingdom
- The only national flag in the world not to include any of the colours red, white, or blue
trivia:
- The flag's original motto was Hardships there are, but the land is green and the sun shineth; this is now rephrased as The sun shineth, the land is green, and the people are strong and creative
- Jamaica's flag is one of only two national flags (with Mauritania's) not to feature any red, white, or blue
- The saltire design was chosen partly because an earlier horizontal proposal was similar to Tanganyika's adopted flag
